native_byte_entropy_selection.global_scope: Preserve reviewed global secret exclusions through the unchanged native base. Retain native source-path policy, including office/PDF/binary and .git exclusions; source also excludes Bun lockfiles. No source-policy equivalence claim.
native_byte_entropy_selection.arithmetic_scope: Ascending 256-byte histogram, per-count binary64 division by byte length, and accumulation in byte order. ASCII rule languages; no arbitrary-platform libm-bit or invalid-UTF-8 source-string equivalence claim.
native_byte_entropy_selection.predicate_scope: Wrap each of the 13 source regexes in its own noncapturing group before native allowlist joining. Preserve all internal flags and alternatives; do not translate predicate whitespace. Retain both case-insensitive secret stopwords.
native_byte_entropy_selection.inherited_global_reachability: For these six fixed lowercase prefixes, source regex 1 is the only reachable global regex. Regex 2 requires an entire repeated-letter, star or dot value; regexes 3 through 13 require leading $, {, %, @ or /. None of those forms intersects a captured provider token. Consequently inherited legacy cross-alternative flags cannot change this six-rule domain. Native local copies retain independent source scopes explicitly.

shared_delimiter_selection.scope: Opt-in raw-byte delimiter increments. No ordinary-delimiter aliases, contextual-preamble changes, online validation, catalog completeness or source-path equivalence.
shared_delimiter_selection.arithmetic: Ascending byte histogram, per-count binary64 division and accumulation; reject H <= threshold. No cross-platform libm-bit equality claim.

contextual_delimiter_selection.scope: Twenty context-sensitive families with disjoint terminal/context-VT companions, three VT-only residuals, and old OpenAI segment-pair endings. Excludes public Lob and Mailgun rows.
contextual_delimiter_selection.global_flag_scope_proof: Captured domains cannot start $, {, %, @ or slash, which are required by flag-sensitive inherited global expressions 3..13. Expression 2 retains its own case scope; expression 1 keeps its source alternation. Sonar bare letters and quoted Terraform values retain all source exclusions.
contextual_delimiter_selection.enumeration: First-VT alternations are disjoint for a particular source assignment. Distinct assignments or repeated context labels may still produce overlapping occurrences under existing native enumeration; no cross-engine enumeration equivalence claim.
